gr08.title: Announcement of the commencement of sales of plant protection products (PPPs)
gr08.text: Τhe procedure relates to announcement of the commencement of sales of plant protection products (PPPs). A plant protection product shop or store is the space where producers obtain pesticides to use on their crops. This is addressed to citizens, business undertakings and legal entities. Basic information Relating to amendment of Joint Ministerial Decision of Law 307752/18-11-2010 (Government Gazette, Series II, of Law 1865) regarding the conditions for submitting an application, the model application forms, the fees and the procedure. gr09.text: The procedure concerns the announcement of the practice of the profession of silversmiths, second-hand sellers, pawnbrokers and those engaged in the purchase or sale of used jewelry and fine jewelry from gold and other valuables. These professionals announce the practice at the police station of their headquarters. The relevant announcement can be submitted electronically with the personal passwords to TAXISnet and the interested party is informed about the progress of his case by e-mail. Basic information Practice of the professions of money changers, antique dealers, pawnbrokers and persons

gr11.title: Announcement of the Operation of A Private Centre for the Technical Inspection of Vehicles (CTIV)
gr11.text: This procedure concerns the announcement of the operation of a private Centre for the Technical Inspection of Vehicles. It refers to natural persons and legal entities. Basic information Private vehicle technical-inspection centres are licensed under Laws 2963/2001 (Series I, 268) and 3919/2011 (Series I, 32). Law 2963/2001 (Series I, 268), “Organisation and operation of public passenger transport by bus, vehicle technical inspection, land-transport safety and other provisions”, has the following amendments: — Law 4850/2021 (Series I, 208), Article 73, amending Articles 34 and 36 of Law 2963/2

gr12.title: Announcement of the Operation of a Private Vehicle Technical Inspection Centre (IKTEO) Following Transfer to a New Owner
gr12.text: The procedure concerns the announcement of the operation of a Private Vehicle Inspection Centre (I.K.T.E.O.), in the case of the transfer of the existing licence to a new owner. More specifically, it concerns the request for the issue of a new Confirmation of Lawful Operation after the transfer of the operating licence or Confirmation of Legal Operation of the Private Vehicle Inspection Centre, by the former to the new owner. In this case, a Certificate of Legal Operation of the Private Vehicle Inspection Centre is issued under the name of the new owner. Basic information Law 2963/2001 (ΦΕΚ 26

gr13.text: The procedure concerns the announcement of the operation of an exhibition by an organizer who is permanently established in Greece. The notification of the concerned organizer is submitted to the relevant municipality or, in the case of an international exhibition, to the relevant Region. It is addressed to citizens, businesses and legal entities. gr14.text: This procedure concerns the announcement of the operation of a trade fair in an exhibition centre or space by a cross-border organiser, as defined by article 2 of Law 4512/2018. gr19.text: The procedure concerns the approval of establishment of laboratories for meat slicing and for standardization, as well as for meat preparations from ungulates and poultry. The established meat slicing and standardization laboratories are facilities used for meat slicing, boning, meat processing, meat packaging, minced meat production, production of meat products and their freezing. It is noted that another code is required for ungulate meat and another for poultry. Basic information Simplification of the framework for carrying out food-manufacturing and related activities, and standardisation

gr20.title: Approval of the operation of recreational activities on land within tourist ports
gr20.text: The procedure concerns the authorisation of the operation of amusement parks, circuses and ice-skating rinks, which are carried out in a covered or open-air area on land within a tourist port. Basic information New institutional framework for the exercise of economic activity and other provisions — CHAPTER XIX: FRAMEWORK FOR THE OPERATION OF AMUSEMENT PARKS, CIRCUSES AND ICE-SKATING RINKS, as added by Article 3 of Law 4796/2021 (Series I, 63) — AMENDMENTS: Article 41 of Law 4872/2021 (Series I, 247) — Article 75 of Law 4914/2022 (Series I, 61). gr21.title: Attestation that a Shop may be established at the specific location
gr21.text: Issue of an attestation to the interested party (natural or legal person) that the shop may be established at the specific location. Concerns (a) Shops of sanitary interest (KYE), (b) theatres and cinemas. Does not concern: the stores of sanitary interest within tourist accommodation, within the facilities of special tourist infrastructures of par.1 of Law 4276/2014, shops of sanitary interest within land port area and shops of sanitary interest within seagoing ships. Basic information Notification of operation. Legal references https://api.et.gr/apiFEK/1/2016/230/pdf Law 285 3463 2006 114 Α D

gr22.text: The procedure concerns the issuance of an authorisation to engage in the occupation of road haulage operator or the renewal of the authorisation to engage in the occupation of road haulage operator. In the case of an application for the renewal of the authorisation to engage in the occupation of road haulage operator due to its expiry, all the supporting documents relating to the issuance of the authorisation to engage in the occupation of road haulage operator shall be submitted, in addition to the expired authorisation (document) to engage in the occupation of road haulage operator. gr23.text: The procedure concerns the issue of a certificate of annual activity in short-term markets. The certificate of annual activity in short-term markets is issued to natural and legal persons from the municipalities and regions. It enables the holder to apply for his participation as a seller in short-term markets under Law 4849/2021 (A-207), i.e. to short-day holidays, religious festivals, Christmas markets and Easter markets, commercial fairs, anniversary markets, seasonal markets, seasonal markets and raccoon markets throughout the country. gr24.text: The procedure concerns the announcement of operation of truck stations for loading-unloading goods or for temporary storage of goods, of type A (with a usable surface from 250 sq.m. to 800 sq.m. as defined in Article 9 (par. 3.1) of Law 79/2004, without installation of fuel pumps, as well as the announcement of possible changes/modifications of these installations. Through these procedures, the Certificate of Lawful Operation is issued (Circular No. 13929/929/11.3.2014), provided that all legal requirements are met. gr25.text: The procedure concerns the certificate of suitability for administrative and other staff of a Casino Business and the issue of a Suitability Card, Occupational Efficiency Card, as the administrative and other staff, chief and assistant, a Casino License Holder is required to have obtained a certificate of suitability from the Committee from the Hellenic Gaming Commission. sa02.text: Electronic only. Attachments: photo of the shop front, lease contract, title deed or investment contract, sanitation contract (optional), safety equipment invoice or safety report from the Civil Defense, copy of the building permit. Issued together with the Civil Defense safety permit. 1 to 10 days; fees apply.

sa03.title: Issuing a fast-track commercial license
sa03.text: Commercial license with a safety permit for some activities; log in as owner or establishment manager when linked to a commercial register. 1 to 10 days.

sa04.title: Renewing a commercial license
sa04.text: Not possible if the commercial registration has expired. Needs the lease, deed or investment contract and a safety equipment certificate or accredited technical report.

sa05.title: Issuing a building permit
sa05.text: Building or fencing permit applied for through an engineering office; permit details sent to the electricity and water companies, Civil Defense, the insurer and the real estate registry.

sa06.title: Issuance of a building occupancy and compliance certificate
sa06.text: The compliance certificate is valid three years and issued with the occupancy certificate; no municipal fees.

sa07.title: Issuance of a health certificate for food workers
sa07.text: For workers in food and public-health establishments (restaurants, barbershops, laundries). Medical examination at a Ministry of Health approved centre; valid one year. 4 to 10 days.

sa08.title: Renewal of a health certificate
sa08.text: Verification of the business license and of the worker's profession, medical examination, health education programme if applicable.

sa09.title: Issuance of a seasonal health certificate
sa09.text: Seasonal variant of the worker health certificate.

sa10.title: Permit for 24-hour commercial activities
sa10.text: Linked to the commercial license and cancelled with it; renewable when 30 days or fewer remain.

sa12.title: Safety license (Salama portal)
sa12.text: Requirements vary with the classification and size of the business; applications on the Salama portal.

sa13.title: VAT registration for businesses
sa13.text: For companies with an economic activity subject to VAT; a VAT account number is assigned upon registration.

sa14.title: VAT registration for individuals
sa14.text: Individuals engaged in economic activity; mandatory above SAR 375,000 of annual revenue, optional between 187,500 and 375,000. 5 working days.

sa15.title: VAT registration for a group
sa15.text: Two or more legal persons registered as one VAT group. 3 working days.

sa16.title: Zakat and income tax registration
sa16.text: After registration with the Ministry of Commerce; the TIN is generated automatically when the commercial registration is issued.

sa17.title: Verify VAT registration
sa17.text: By VAT account number, commercial registration number or VAT certificate number; instant.

sa18.title: Update VAT registration details
sa18.text: Amendments to registration details including financial details, with supporting documents. 3 working days.

sa19.title: Register a new establishment or branch in GOSI
sa19.text: After registration the establishment can obtain the GOSI certificate proving its registration.

sa20.title: Visa issuance for an establishment
sa20.text: Valid commercial register (except activities that do not need one), existing establishment, wage-protection compliance, allowed activity; payment.

sa21.title: Employee transfer from another employer
sa21.text: Through Qiwa; valid commercial register; employment contract for each worker.

sa22.title: Renewal of residence permit (Iqama)
sa22.text: Through Absher or Muqeem; valid passport, fees paid, medical insurance; fines start three days after expiry.

sa23.title: Extension of an exit and re-entry visa
sa23.text: Through Absher or Muqeem, including for residents outside the Kingdom.

sa24.title: Final exit visa
sa24.text: The residence permit must be valid at least 30 days; the visa lasts at most 60 days.
